title: Every unknown outcome retains the reservation, whatever its cause
description: T-011 and T-012 in one table. A transmission that never completed, a cross-origin redirect refused after the signature had already reached the merchant, and a 5xx are three different causes with one disposition: the outcome is unknown, so the reservation is held to its TTL. Each reports a distinct causeCategory so a caller can tell them apart without any of them changing what happens to the money. All three are given attempt 1 of 3 deliberately: an ambiguous outcome does not consume the remaining attempts, it ends the loop, because retrying could pay twice.
